blocks.text: Kisi bhi tehqeeq ya analysis mein data jama karna aur tayyar karna zaroori qadam hain: data ka maeyar aur munasibat seedhe nataij par asar dalte hain. Yeh hissa jama karne ke tareeqe aur analysis ke liye data ki tayyari batata hai.

blocks.prompt: Kharab data kharab nataij kyun deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Koi bhi analysis ya model utna hi durust ho sakta hai jitna us ka data; ghaltiyan, khala ya ghair mutalliqa data seedhe nataij mein chale jate hain.

items: Achhe nataij ke liye achha data: ehtiyat se jama karein aur analysis se pehle tayyar karein.
